question: Compare Q3 and Q4 performance for our best region.

    SELECT region

    ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC

)

    strftime('%Y-Q%q', o.order_date) AS quarter,
    SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count

JOIN
    customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN
    best_region br ON c.region = br.region
WHERE
    strftime('%Y-Q%q', o.order_date) IN ('2023-Q3', '2024-Q3', '2023-Q4', '2024-Q4')

question: List the second-most-popular product in each category.

  SELECT
    p.category,
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(o.quantity) AS total_quantity,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(o.quantity) DESC) AS rank

    products p

    orders o ON p.product_id = o.product_id

    p.category, p.product_id, p.product_name
)
SELECT
  category,
  product_id,
  product_name,
  total_quantity
FROM
  category_popularity
WHERE
  rank = 2;
